commits.subject: Document the inventory read and coverage components
commits.body:
Add five legacy-format Component definitions for the delivered read
projection, public read queries, inventory coverage, inherited selection
coverage and inventory reconciliation, and one System explaining how the
consumers use the projection. Each reference names an exact current
range. Existing shared inventory records are left for the coordinated
repair; app.saga does not adopt inventory format 2.

commits.body:

and Systems; they now describe current technical definitions, edge
evidence and the separate count of proposed edges.

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Explain the implemented inventory reads, coverage and reconciliation
commits.body:
Add five implementation slides to the technical inventory deck, ranks
200-204 under 'Implemented reads and coverage': scoped and filtered
reads with a separate unresolved page, declared reverse uses with
explicit completeness, inherited coverage from exact selections,
inventory coverage of a named scope, and inventory reconciliation. Each
Item carries exact evidence at the current code and pinned links to the
criteria it explains; Items pin the new read and coverage components.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.body:
Six review slides explain the b6c07006..HEAD transition: scoped and
filtered reads, declared reverse uses, inherited selection coverage,
the inventory coverage report, inventory reconciliation, and the public

No review decision is recorded.

commits.body:
